S1_replacementAnchors.rule: prereg §2 (frozen 160cc28b5): c_pos = src/draft/displacement.waiver_values_by_position (best unrostered rankDerivedValue at the position, newest board, dynasty_main rosters); '*' (unknown position AND every pick) = FAAB V_repl from src/trade/faab_engine.resolve_anchors, built as server.py's FAAB route builds it

K.anchorSource: * (FAAB V_repl) — no priced unrostered player at this position on the board

S1_replacementAnchors.picks: Picks take '*' = league-wide FAAB V_repl.  A pick is not a waiver-wire replacement for a roster spot (displacement._available_players excludes picks), so no per-position waiver level exists for it; V_repl is the league's format-level replacement value (board rank ~2x the starting pool, blended with the live pool).
notes: Kickers carry no canonical value on this board (0 priced K rows), so K has no anchor of its own and no K asset enters any trade below.
li5_* tiers run the exact lineup optimizer with rosValue := rankDerivedValue (canonical scale), so they are canonical-value replacement levels, not projections.

S2_classification.rule: prereg §3: genuine starter = in a dynasty_main roster's canonical optimal lineup (contract sleeper.teams[].optimalLineup.starters); an UNROSTERED asset is a starter when its value >= the lowest starter value at its position across the 12 lineups; usable depth = not a starter and value >= its position anchor; expendable filler = value < its position anchor.  Picks: value vs '*' (never 'starter'; >= '*' is reported as depth).  Rookie-class picks (e.g. '2027 Pick 1.10') and future-year tier picks are reported separately and never pooled with players.

design.compositions: 'any' (assets of the class drawn freely) and 'starters_only' (every base asset a §3 genuine starter); picks have no starters_only bases
design.sweeteners: 1-4 assets drawn ONCE per base and category (filler / depth / starter, same class as the base; mixed draws across classes) and added to the side that is behind on raw value; identical cases for every treatment
design.flip: PRIMARY flips = the verdict crosses a region for the sweetening side (disfavoured -> fair, disfavoured -> favoured, or fair -> favoured), the shared classifier (fairness_bands_v1, the larger ADJUSTED side (RETIRED, reproduction only)); this is what F1/F3 count.  Secondary: verdictChanged = any change of the signed level (e.g. lopsided -> unfair against); winnerFlipped = disfavoured -> favoured; unfairMadeFair = disfavoured -> FAIR
design.criteriaThresholds: F1 filler-only flips fall >= 80% vs GEOM_78; F2 starter-only base trades level changes <= 2%; F3 usable-depth flips fall <= 25%; <100 flip cases (or <100 starter-only bases for F2) = insufficient
design.incumbentNote: GEOM_78 here is the exact geometric utility (q = 0.78); production rounds the adjustment to an integer, which moves no level in this study by design of the bands (absolute minimum 250).

S4_realExamples.convention: gapA = adjusted A minus adjusted B (positive favours A); level = fairness_bands_v1, the larger ADJUSTED side (RETIRED, reproduction only) (shared classifier); values = today's board; §3 class in each label
